data.title: 拉姆 · 提灯回廊
data.description: 夜里巡过长廊时，拉姆举起手灯照向门牌，确认最后一间房的门已经关好。
data.promptProse: Making her late-night rounds along a quiet wooden corridor of the Roswaal mansion, Ram pauses in her black-and-white maid dress beside the last guest room doorway. She lifts a small brass hand lantern up toward the carved wooden door and nameplate, checking the latch with composed attentiveness. Warm flickering lantern light illuminates her profile, crisp white apron, and the paneled hallway fading into deep night shadow.
data.animaCaption: Pausing along the dark timber corridor in her maid uniform, Ram raises a glowing hand lantern toward the closed wooden doorway and nameplate. Warm lantern light picks out her composed profile and the wood paneling against the night shadows.
